source: art/scene/bake_live.py on the lookdev-06 scene (Blender 4.5 LTS, Cycles), quality 85 WebP
units: Blender units = three.js units; three.js (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y)

cameras.hero: Blender (0, 0, 4.2), straight down, vertical FOV 30, image up = Blender +y; three.js position (0, 4.2, 0), lookAt (0, 0, 0), up (0, 0, -1), fov 30; desktop 1600x1000 (aspect 1.6), phone 900x1200 (aspect 0.75)
cameras.book: closed book centred at the origin: cover 0.78 x 1.04, spine edge at x = -0.39, cover top at height 0.105

colour: all files are sRGB; the lit files carry the AgX look and the ember grade of the stills

book_shadow_desktop.webp.contains: the closed book's shadow and contact darkening alone: black, alpha = 1 - (desk with book hidden from camera) / (desk without book); draw over the desk plate with normal alpha blending, under the live book
book_shadow_desktop.webp.uv: screen-aligned: covers the whole 1600x1000 viewport of the hero_desktop camera (Blender (0, 0, 4.2) looking down, vertical FOV 30; three.js (0, 4.2, 0), up (0, 0, -1)); top row = far edge of the desk (three.js -z)

book_shadow_phone.webp.contains: the closed book's shadow and contact darkening alone: black, alpha = 1 - (desk with book hidden from camera) / (desk without book); draw over the desk plate with normal alpha blending, under the live book
book_shadow_phone.webp.uv: screen-aligned: covers the whole 900x1200 viewport of the hero_phone camera (Blender (0, 0, 4.2) looking down, vertical FOV 30; three.js (0, 4.2, 0), up (0, 0, -1)); top row = far edge of the desk (three.js -z)

cover_front.webp.contains: the front cover's top face, orthographic from above: leather, the deboss ring and frame, the intact seal. Lit: lamp, kicker and bounce as in lookdev-06, AgX and the ember grade, so it already looks as it does in the stills; show it unlit (MeshBasicMaterial, sRGB, no tone mapping) or the live light will double it.
cover_front.webp.uv: u = 0 at the spine edge, 1 at the fore edge (Blender x -0.39..0.39, three.js x likewise); v = 1 (top row) at the head (Blender +y, three.js -z), 0 at the tail; spans the full 0.78 x 1.04 cover including the 4.5 mm bevel, so the extreme corners show a few pixels of desk. Matches PlaneGeometry default UVs on a plane laid flat with rotation.x = -PI/2 and x running from the spine.
